core_obligations: Reduction (proof lines 5776-5782): replace C by C/X so that X is final and C has all finite limits.

The locally-given data (lines 5784-5805): B is the full subcategory of objects admitting a morphism to some U_{i(U)}; E_U = a_U^* E_{i(U)}; a morphism a : U -> U' factors through U_{i(U')i(U)} = U_{i(U')} x_X U_{i(U)}, and pulling back rho_{i(U')i(U)} along the factorization gives rho_a : a^*E_{U'} -> E_U; the cocycle condition for the rho_a follows from condition (1) of the lemma by pulling back the cocycle identities along the maps into the triple fibre products (the author marks this transfer 'details omitted' - auxiliary bookkeeping, see notes); the data satisfy the requirements of the locally-given situation.

Applying the glueing theorem (lines 5807-5828): assumptions (1) and (2)(a) were just verified, (2)(b) is clear, (2)(c) holds because {U_i -> X} is a covering (the author's footnote: surjectivity of the coproduct of the h_{U_i} on sheafification would suffice), (3) holds by the negative-Ext vanishing, (4) by the cohomological bound t; the theorem yields a unique pair (E, rho_U), and rho_i = rho_{U_i} is the desired glueing.
proof_roadmap: Replace C by C/X and define the locally-given data (B, E_U, rho_a) from the E_i and rho_{ij}.
Transfer the cocycle condition from the rho_{ij} to the rho_a.
Check the five assumptions of the general glueing theorem and conclude uniqueness.
